segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Glossary
segments.tr: ## 📚 Glossário de Hoje

segments.src: - **Food crop** — a crop grown mainly to be consumed directly as human food, such as grains, pulses, and starchy tubers.
segments.tr: - **Cultura alimentar** — uma cultura cultivada principalmente para ser consumida diretamente como alimento humano, como cereais, leguminosas e tubérculos amiláceos.

segments.src: - **Industrial crop** — a crop grown as raw material for processing into fiber, oil, sugar, or other non-food products, such as cotton, canola, or sugarcane.
segments.tr: - **Cultura industrial** — uma cultura cultivada como matéria-prima para processamento em fibra, óleo, açúcar ou outros produtos não alimentares, como algodão, canola ou cana-de-açúcar.

segments.src: - **Annual / biennial / perennial** — plants that complete their life cycle in one season, two seasons, or that persist and produce for multiple years.
segments.tr: - **Anual / bienal / perene** — plantas que completam seu ciclo de vida em uma estação, duas estações, ou que persistem e produzem por vários anos.

segments.src: - **Growth stage** — a defined step in a crop's development (germination, vegetative, reproductive, filling, maturity) used to time management decisions.
segments.tr: - **Estágio de crescimento** — uma etapa definida no desenvolvimento de uma cultura (germinação, vegetativa, reprodutiva, preenchimento, maturidade) usada para cronometrar decisões de manejo.

segments.src: - **Growing degree days (GDD)** — accumulated heat units used to predict crop development, since crops track temperature rather than calendar days.
segments.tr: - **Dias de graus de crescimento (GDD)** — unidades de calor acumulado usadas para prever o desenvolvimento da cultura, já que as culturas rastreiam a temperatura em vez dos dias do calendário.

segments.src: - **Physiological maturity** — the point at which a seed or fruit stops accumulating dry matter; in corn it is marked by the black layer at the kernel base.
segments.tr: - **Maturidade fisiológica** — o ponto em que uma semente ou fruto para de acumular matéria seca; em milho é marcado pela camada preta na base do grão.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** Classification follows intended use, and cotton fiber goes into textile processing rather than onto a plate, making it an industrial crop.
segments.tr: *Respostas: **Q1 — B.** A classificação segue o uso pretendido, e a fibra de algodão vai para o processamento têxtil em vez de para um prato, tornando-a uma cultura industrial.

segments.src: (Cottonseed oil is a reminder that one plant can serve more than one category.)
segments.tr: (O óleo de sementes de algodão é um lembrete de que uma planta pode servir mais de uma categoria.)

segments.src: **Q2 — True.** Annuals such as soybeans, corn, and wheat go from seed to seed in a single season, which is why they are replanted every year.
segments.tr: **Q2 — Verdadeiro.** Anuais como soja, milho e trigo vão de semente a semente em uma única estação, razão pela qual são replantadas a cada ano.

segments.src: **Q3 — C.** Pollination is the bottleneck: stress at silking causes pollination failure and unfilled kernels, and that lost yield cannot be recovered later in the season.
segments.tr: **Q3 — C.** A polinização é o gargalo: o estresse no penteamento causa falha na polinização e grãos não preenchidos, e esse rendimento perdido não pode ser recuperado mais tarde na estação.

segments.src: Stress at VE or V6 is damaging but far more recoverable, and by R6 the yield is already set.*
segments.tr: O estresse em VE ou V6 é prejudicial, mas muito mais recuperável, e por R6 o rendimento já está definido.*

in.title: [Pertanian 101 #2] Jagung, Kapas, dan Kedelai Masuk ke Ladang: Bagaimana Tanaman Dikelompokkan dan Bagaimana Mereka Tumbuh

segments.src: > Farmers don't just grow "plants" — they grow specific crop classes with specific end uses, and every one of them moves through the same predictable life stages, pushed along by five environmental levers.
segments.tr: > Petani tidak hanya menanam "tanaman" — mereka menanam kelas tanaman spesifik dengan kegunaan akhir yang spesifik, dan setiap satu dari mereka bergerak melalui tahap kehidupan yang sama dan dapat diprediksi, didorong oleh lima pengungkit lingkungan.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Walk through any farm and you'll see plants.
segments.tr: Berjalan melalui ladang apa pun dan Anda akan melihat tanaman.

segments.src: Walk through it like an agronomist and you'll see **categories**.
segments.tr: Berjalan melaluinya seperti ahli agronomi dan Anda akan melihat **kategori**.

segments.src: The first split is by **what the crop is for**.
segments.tr: Pemisahan pertama adalah berdasarkan **untuk apa tanaman tersebut**.

segments.src: Two of the big buckets:
segments.tr: Dua dari kategori besar:

segments.src: - **Food crops** — grown to be eaten more or less directly. Grains (corn, wheat, rice), pulses (soybeans, dry beans), and starchy roots and tubers (potatoes, sweet potatoes). Roughly speaking, these supply calories.
segments.tr: - **Tanaman pangan** — ditanam untuk dimakan lebih atau kurang langsung. Biji-bijian (jagung, gandum, beras), kacang-kacangan (kedelai, buncis kering), dan akar bertepung serta umbi (kentang, ubi jalar). Secara garis besar, ini menyediakan kalori.

segments.src: - **Industrial crops** (sometimes called *technical* or *cash* crops) — grown as raw material for processing rather than as a plate of food. Cotton and flax for fiber; soybeans, canola, and peanuts for oil; sugarcane and sugar beets for sugar; tobacco, hops, and hemp as specialty inputs.
segments.tr: - **Tanaman industri** (kadang disebut *teknis* atau *tanaman uang*) — ditanam sebagai bahan baku untuk diproses daripada sebagai makanan di piring. Kapas dan rami untuk serat; kedelai, kanola, dan kacang tanah untuk minyak; tebu dan bit gula untuk gula; tembakau, hops, dan ganja industri sebagai masukan khusus.

segments.src: Note that the line is fuzzy on purpose.
segments.tr: Perhatikan bahwa garis ini sengaja kabur.

segments.src: Soybeans are a food crop and an oil crop and a livestock feed.
segments.tr: Kedelai adalah tanaman pangan dan tanaman minyak dan pakan ternak.

segments.src: Corn is breakfast cereal, ethanol, high-fructose corn syrup, and cattle feed.
segments.tr: Jagung adalah sereal sarapan, etanol, sirup jagung fruktosa tinggi, dan pakan sapi.

segments.src: Classification follows **intended use**, not botany, so the same species can sit in two boxes at once.
segments.tr: Klasifikasi mengikuti **penggunaan yang dimaksudkan**, bukan botani, sehingga spesies yang sama dapat berada di dua kotak sekaligus.

segments.src: A second useful split is by **life span**:
segments.tr: Pemisahan berguna kedua adalah berdasarkan **rentang hidup**:

segments.src: - **Annuals** finish seed-to-seed in one season (corn, soybeans, wheat).
segments.tr: - **Tahunan** menyelesaikan benih ke benih dalam satu musim (jagung, kedelai, gandum).

segments.src: - **Biennials** need two seasons (sugar beets, carrots grown for seed).
segments.tr: - **Dwi tahunan** memerlukan dua musim (bit gula, wortel yang ditanam untuk benih).

segments.src: - **Perennials** live for years (alfalfa, asparagus, apple trees, grapevines).
segments.tr: - **Abadi** hidup selama bertahun-tahun (alfalfa, asparagus, pohon apel, pohon anggur).

segments.src: Now the second half of today's lesson: **growth stages**.
segments.tr: Sekarang bagian kedua dari pelajaran hari ini: **tahap pertumbuhan**.

segments.src: Whatever the category, a crop moves through a recognizable sequence:
segments.tr: Apa pun kategorinya, tanaman bergerak melalui urutan yang dapat dikenali:

segments.src: 1. **Germination and emergence** — the seed takes up water, the root and shoot break out, the seedling reaches light.
segments.tr: 1. **Perkecambahan dan kemunculan** — benih menyerap air, akar dan tunas keluar, bibit mencapai cahaya.

segments.src: 2. **Vegetative growth** — leaves, stems, and roots build the factory. No yield yet, just capacity.
segments.tr: 2. **Pertumbuhan vegetatif** — daun, batang, dan akar membangun pabrik. Belum ada hasil dulu, hanya kapasitas.

segments.src: 3. **Reproductive growth** — flowering and pollination. The plant switches from building to committing.
segments.tr: 3. **Pertumbuhan reproduktif** — berbunga dan penyerbukan. Tanaman beralih dari membangun ke berkomitmen.

segments.src: 4. **Grain fill / fruit development** — sugars made in the leaves get moved into seeds, tubers, or fruit.
segments.tr: 4. **Pengisian butir / pengembangan buah** — gula yang dibuat di daun dipindahkan ke benih, umbi, atau buah.

segments.src: 5. **Maturity and senescence** — moisture drops, the plant shuts down, harvest window opens.
segments.tr: 5. **Kematangan dan penuaan** — kelembaban turun, tanaman mati, jendela panen terbuka.

segments.src: Agronomists give these stages formal codes.
segments.tr: Ahli agronomi memberikan kode formal untuk tahap-tahap ini.

segments.src: Corn uses V-stages and R-stages (V6 = six collared leaves, R1 = silking, R6 = physiological maturity).
segments.tr: Jagung menggunakan tahap V dan R (V6 = enam daun berkerah, R1 = bersutra, R6 = kematangan fisiologis).

segments.src: Soybeans use their own V/R scale.
segments.tr: Kedelai menggunakan skala V/R mereka sendiri.

segments.src: Many crops worldwide use the **BBCH scale**, a 0–99 numbering system that lets a researcher in Nebraska and one in France mean the same thing by "stage 65."
segments.tr: Banyak tanaman di seluruh dunia menggunakan **skala BBCH**, sistem penomoran 0–99 yang memungkinkan peneliti di Nebraska dan satu di Prancis berarti hal yang sama dengan "tahap 65."

segments.src: Why bother with stages?
segments.tr: Mengapa repot-repot dengan tahap?

segments.src: Because **timing is the whole game**.
segments.tr: Karena **timing adalah seluruh permainan**.

segments.src: The same input at a different stage gives a different result.
segments.tr: Masukan yang sama pada tahap yang berbeda memberikan hasil yang berbeda.

segments.src: Nitrogen at V6 corn feeds a plant that's about to explode in growth; the same nitrogen at R5 is largely wasted.
segments.tr: Nitrogen pada jagung V6 memberi makan tanaman yang akan meledak dalam pertumbuhan; nitrogen yang sama pada R5 sebagian besar terbuang sia-sia.

segments.src: A week of drought at silking costs far more yield than a week of drought in early vegetative growth.
segments.tr: Seminggu kekeringan saat bersutra menyebabkan kehilangan hasil jauh lebih banyak daripada seminggu kekeringan dalam pertumbuhan vegetatif awal.

segments.src: Stage-awareness is how a farmer turns a calendar into a decision tool.
segments.tr: Kesadaran tahap adalah bagaimana petani mengubah kalender menjadi alat pengambilan keputusan.

segments.src: And what drives movement through those stages?
segments.tr: Dan apa yang mendorong pergerakan melalui tahap-tahap tersebut?

segments.src: Five **environmental factors**:
segments.tr: Lima **faktor lingkungan**:

segments.src: - **Temperature** — the pace-setter. Development tracks accumulated heat, not days. Hence *growing degree days*, computed in plain terms as `GDD = (daily high + daily low) / 2 - base temperature`, with corn's base commonly taken as 50 degrees F.
segments.tr: - **Suhu** — penentu kecepatan. Pengembangan melacak panas yang terkumpul, bukan hari. Oleh karena itu *hari derajat tumbuh*, dihitung dalam istilah sederhana sebagai `GDD = (tinggi harian + rendah harian) / 2 - suhu dasar`, dengan dasar jagung umumnya diambil sebagai 50 derajat F.

segments.src: - **Water** — the solvent, the transport system, and the coolant. Both drought and waterlogging (which starves roots of oxygen) cut yield.
segments.tr: - **Air** — pelarut, sistem transportasi, dan pendingin. Baik kekeringan maupun genangan air (yang membuat akar kekurangan oksigen) mengurangi hasil.

segments.src: - **Light** — energy for photosynthesis, and for many crops a *signal*. Short-day plants like soybeans start flowering as nights lengthen, which is why a variety bred for Iowa behaves strangely in Georgia.
segments.tr: - **Cahaya** — energi untuk fotosintesis, dan untuk banyak tanaman *sinyal*. Tanaman hari pendek seperti kedelai mulai berbunga saat malam memanjang, itulah mengapa varietas yang dibiakkan untuk Iowa berperilaku aneh di Georgia.

segments.src: - **Soil and nutrients** — texture, pH, organic matter, and the supply of nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, and micronutrients.
segments.tr: - **Tanah dan nutrisi** — tekstur, pH, bahan organik, dan pasokan nitrogen, fosfor, kalium, dan mikronutrien.

segments.src: - **Air** — carbon dioxide as photosynthetic raw material, plus wind and oxygen at the root zone.
segments.tr: - **Udara** — karbon dioksida sebagai bahan baku fotosintesis, ditambah angin dan oksigen di zona akar.

segments.src: The old agronomy shorthand still holds: yield tends to be capped by whichever factor is shortest in supply.
segments.tr: Singkatan agronomi lama masih berlaku: hasil cenderung dibatasi oleh faktor mana pun yang paling terbatas.

segments.src: Perfect fertility doesn't rescue a crop that ran out of water at flowering.
segments.tr: Kesuburan sempurna tidak menyelamatkan tanaman yang kehabisan air saat berbunga.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Picture an Iowa corn-and-soybean farm on a 1,000-acre section — the kind of operation you drive past for an hour straight on I-80.
segments.tr: Bayangkan ladang jagung-dan-kedelai Iowa di bagian 1.000 hektar — jenis operasi yang Anda lewati selama satu jam lurus di I-80.

segments.src: Late April: the planter goes in the ground once soil temperature at 2 inches holds near 50 degrees F.
segments.tr: Akhir April: penanam masuk ke tanah setelah suhu tanah pada 2 inci mencapai dekat 50 derajat F.

segments.src: Plant into cold, wet soil and germination stalls, seedlings sit vulnerable, and stands come up ragged.
segments.tr: Tanam ke tanah dingin dan basah dan perkecambahan macet, bibit duduk rentan, dan berdiri tidak rata.

segments.src: That single temperature threshold is why planting is a weather decision, not a date on the wall.
segments.tr: Ambang suhu tunggal itu adalah alasan mengapa penanaman adalah keputusan cuaca, bukan tanggal di dinding.

segments.src: Mid-June: the corn is knee-high to chest-high, somewhere around V8.
segments.tr: Pertengahan Juni: jagung setinggi lutut hingga dada, sekitar V8.

segments.src: This is vegetative growth — the plant is building leaf area and setting the number of kernel rows it will *attempt* to fill.
segments.tr: Ini adalah pertumbuhan vegetatif — tanaman membangun area daun dan menetapkan jumlah baris kernel yang akan *coba* diisi.

segments.src: Side-dress nitrogen goes on here, because the crop is about to take up the bulk of its season-long nitrogen in a few short weeks.
segments.tr: Nitrogen penambah samping masuk di sini, karena tanaman akan menyerap sebagian besar nitrogen musiman panjangnya dalam beberapa minggu singkat.

segments.src: Mid-July: **silking**, stage R1.
segments.tr: Pertengahan Juli: **bersutra**, tahap R1.

segments.src: This is the most drought-sensitive moment of the entire season.
segments.tr: Ini adalah momen paling sensitif terhadap kekeringan sepanjang musim.

segments.src: Pollen sheds from the tassel, silks catch it, kernels get set.
segments.tr: Serbuk sari rontok dari jambul, serat menangkapnya, kernel diatur.

segments.src: A heat wave now — the sort that spikes into the high 90s for a week — can cause pollination failure, and the farmer will find ears with gaps and bare tips at harvest.
segments.tr: Gelombang panas sekarang — jenis yang naik ke 90-an tinggi selama seminggu — dapat menyebabkan kegagalan penyerbukan, dan petani akan menemukan tongkol dengan celah dan ujung kosong saat panen.

segments.src: Nothing done in August fixes that.
segments.tr: Tidak ada yang dilakukan di Agustus memperbaiki itu.

segments.src: Crop insurance markets and Chicago corn futures move on exactly this two-week window, which is why grain traders watch July forecasts the way sports fans watch a playoff bracket.
segments.tr: Pasar asuransi tanaman dan jagung Chicago futures bergerak pada jendela dua minggu yang tepat ini, itulah mengapa pedagang biji-bijian menonton prakiraan Juli seperti penggemar olahraga menonton kurung playoff.

segments.src: Early September: **black layer**, stage R6, physiological maturity.
segments.tr: Awal September: **lapisan hitam**, tahap R6, kematangan fisiologis.

segments.src: The kernel forms a dark abscission layer at its base and stops accumulating dry matter.
segments.tr: Kernel membentuk lapisan abscission gelap di pangkalnya dan berhenti mengumpulkan bahan kering.

segments.src: Yield is now locked.
segments.tr: Hasil sekarang terkunci.

segments.src: Everything from here is a drying-and-logistics problem: harvest at around 20–25 percent kernel moisture, then run the grain dryer down to about 15 percent for safe storage.
segments.tr: Segala sesuatu dari sini adalah masalah pengeringan dan logistik: panen pada sekitar 20–25 persen kelembaban kernel, kemudian jalankan pengering biji-bijian hingga sekitar 15 persen untuk penyimpanan yang aman.

segments.src: Propane for that dryer can run tens of thousands of dollars for a wet fall — a real line item, not a rounding error.
segments.tr: Propana untuk pengering itu dapat berjalan puluhan ribu dolar untuk musim gugur basah — item baris nyata, bukan kesalahan pembulatan.

segments.src: Meanwhile the same farm's soybeans are running their own R-scale, and 600 miles south in the Mississippi Delta a cotton grower — an industrial crop, grown for fiber, not calories — is tracking squares, blooms, and bolls on a completely different clock.
segments.tr: Sementara itu kedelai ladang yang sama menjalankan skala R mereka sendiri, dan 600 mil ke selatan di Delta Mississippi seorang penanam kapas — tanaman industri, ditanam untuk serat, bukan kalori — melacak persegi, mekar, dan bolls pada jam yang benar-benar berbeda.

segments.src: Same five environmental factors.
segments.tr: Lima faktor lingkungan yang sama.

segments.src: Same underlying logic.
segments.tr: Logika yang sama.

segments.src: Different crop class, different calendar, different market.
segments.tr: Kelas tanaman berbeda, kalender berbeda, pasar berbeda.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan Tiga Baris

segments.src: 1. Crops are grouped by intended use — food crops for direct eating, industrial crops as raw material for fiber, oil, sugar, and specialty processing — and by life span as annuals, biennials, or perennials.
segments.tr: 1. Tanaman dikelompokkan berdasarkan penggunaan yang dimaksudkan — tanaman pangan untuk dimakan langsung, tanaman industri sebagai bahan baku untuk serat, minyak, gula, dan pemrosesan khusus — dan berdasarkan rentang hidup sebagai tahunan, dwi tahunan, atau abadi.

segments.src: 2. Every crop moves through germination, vegetative growth, reproduction, filling, and maturity, and agronomists code those stages (corn V/R, the international BBCH scale) so that management decisions can be timed instead of guessed.
segments.tr: 2. Setiap tanaman bergerak melalui perkecambahan, pertumbuhan vegetatif, reproduksi, pengisian, dan kematangan, dan ahli agronomi mengkode tahap-tahap tersebut (jagung V/R, skala BBCH internasional) sehingga keputusan manajemen dapat dipilih waktu daripada ditebak.

segments.src: 3. Progress through the stages is driven by temperature, water, light, soil nutrients, and air, and yield is typically limited by whichever of those is shortest at the crop's most sensitive moment.
segments.tr: 3. Kemajuan melalui tahap-tahap didorong oleh suhu, air, cahaya, nutrisi tanah, dan udara, dan hasil biasanya dibatasi oleh mana pun yang paling terbatas pada saat paling sensitif tanaman.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

segments.src: **Q1.** Cotton grown for fiber is best classified as which of the following?
segments.tr: **Q1.** Kapas yang ditanam untuk serat paling baik diklasifikasikan sebagai mana dari berikut ini?

segments.src: - A) A food crop
segments.tr: - A) Tanaman pangan

segments.src: - B) An industrial crop
segments.tr: - B) Tanaman industri

segments.src: - C) A biennial forage crop
segments.tr: - C) Tanaman pakan dwi tahunan

segments.src: - D) A cover crop
segments.tr: - D) Tanaman penutup

segments.src: **Q2.** True or False: A soybean plant classified as an annual completes its seed-to-seed life cycle within a single growing season.
segments.tr: **Q2.** Benar atau Salah: Tanaman kedelai yang diklasifikasikan sebagai tahunan menyelesaikan siklus hidup benih-ke-benih dalam satu musim tanam tunggal.

segments.src: **Q3.** For a corn crop, which growth stage is generally the most sensitive to drought and heat stress?
segments.tr: **Q3.** Untuk tanaman jagung, tahap pertumbuhan mana yang umumnya paling sensitif terhadap kekeringan dan stres panas?

segments.src: - A) Emergence (VE)
segments.tr: - A) Kemunculan (VE)

segments.src: - B) Six-leaf vegetative growth (V6)
segments.tr: - B) Pertumbuhan vegetatif enam daun (V6)

segments.src: - C) Silking and pollination (R1)
segments.tr: - C) Bersutra dan penyerbukan (R1)

segments.src: - D) Physiological maturity, or black layer (R6)
segments.tr: - D) Kematangan fisiologis, atau lapisan hitam (R6)

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Glossary
segments.tr: ## 📚 Glosari Hari Ini

segments.src: - **Food crop** — a crop grown mainly to be consumed directly as human food, such as grains, pulses, and starchy tubers.
segments.tr: - **Tanaman pangan** — tanaman yang ditanam terutama untuk dikonsumsi langsung sebagai makanan manusia, seperti biji-bijian, kacang-kacangan, dan umbi bertepung.

segments.src: - **Industrial crop** — a crop grown as raw material for processing into fiber, oil, sugar, or other non-food products, such as cotton, canola, or sugarcane.
segments.tr: - **Tanaman industri** — tanaman yang ditanam sebagai bahan baku untuk diproses menjadi serat, minyak, gula, atau produk non-makanan lainnya, seperti kapas, kanola, atau tebu.

segments.src: - **Annual / biennial / perennial** — plants that complete their life cycle in one season, two seasons, or that persist and produce for multiple years.
segments.tr: - **Tahunan / dwi tahunan / abadi** — tanaman yang menyelesaikan siklus hidup mereka dalam satu musim, dua musim, atau yang bertahan dan menghasilkan selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: - **Growth stage** — a defined step in a crop's development (germination, vegetative, reproductive, filling, maturity) used to time management decisions.
segments.tr: - **Tahap pertumbuhan** — langkah yang ditentukan dalam pengembangan tanaman (perkecambahan, vegetatif, reproduktif, pengisian, kematangan) yang digunakan untuk waktu keputusan manajemen.

segments.src: - **Growing degree days (GDD)** — accumulated heat units used to predict crop development, since crops track temperature rather than calendar days.
segments.tr: - **Hari derajat tumbuh (GDD)** — unit panas yang terkumpul digunakan untuk memprediksi pengembangan tanaman, karena tanaman melacak suhu daripada hari kalender.

segments.src: - **Physiological maturity** — the point at which a seed or fruit stops accumulating dry matter; in corn it is marked by the black layer at the kernel base.
segments.tr: - **Kematangan fisiologis** — titik di mana benih atau buah berhenti mengumpulkan bahan kering; di jagung ditandai dengan lapisan hitam di pangkal kernel.

segments.src: *Answers: **Q1 — B.** Classification follows intended use, and cotton fiber goes into textile processing rather than onto a plate, making it an industrial crop.
segments.tr: *Jawaban: **Q1 — B.** Klasifikasi mengikuti penggunaan yang dimaksudkan, dan serat kapas masuk ke pemrosesan tekstil daripada ke piring, menjadikannya tanaman industri.

segments.src: (Cottonseed oil is a reminder that one plant can serve more than one category.)
segments.tr: (Minyak biji kapas adalah pengingat bahwa satu tanaman dapat melayani lebih dari satu kategori.)

segments.src: **Q2 — True.** Annuals such as soybeans, corn, and wheat go from seed to seed in a single season, which is why they are replanted every year.
segments.tr: **Q2 — Benar.** Tahunan seperti kedelai, jagung, dan gandum pergi dari benih ke benih dalam satu musim, itulah mengapa mereka ditanam kembali setiap tahun.

segments.src: **Q3 — C.** Pollination is the bottleneck: stress at silking causes pollination failure and unfilled kernels, and that lost yield cannot be recovered later in the season.
segments.tr: **Q3 — C.** Penyerbukan adalah hambatan: stres saat bersutra menyebabkan kegagalan penyerbukan dan kernel yang tidak terisi, dan hasil yang hilang tidak dapat dipulihkan kemudian di musim.

segments.src: Stress at VE or V6 is damaging but far more recoverable, and by R6 the yield is already set.*
segments.tr: Stres pada VE atau V6 merusak tetapi jauh lebih dapat dipulihkan, dan pada R6 hasil sudah ditetapkan.*

ja.title: [Agriculture 101 #2] トウモロコシ、綿、大豆：作物の分類方法と成長段階

segments.src: > Farmers don't just grow "plants" — they grow specific crop classes with specific end uses, and every one of them moves through the same predictable life stages, pushed along by five environmental levers.
segments.tr: > 農家は単に「植物」を育てるのではなく、特定の用途を持つ特定の作物クラスを育てており、それらはすべて同じ予測可能なライフサイクルステージを経て、5つの環境要因に駆動されます。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 本日のコンセプト

segments.src: Walk through any farm and you'll see plants.
segments.tr: どの農場を歩いても、植物が見えます。

segments.src: Walk through it like an agronomist and you'll see **categories**.
segments.tr: 農学者のように歩けば、**カテゴリー**が見えます。

segments.src: The first split is by **what the crop is for**.
segments.tr: 最初の分け方は**作物の用途**です。

segments.src: Two of the big buckets:
segments.tr: 大きなカテゴリーは次の2つです：

segments.src: - **Food crops** — grown to be eaten more or less directly. Grains (corn, wheat, rice), pulses (soybeans, dry beans), and starchy roots and tubers (potatoes, sweet potatoes). Roughly speaking, these supply calories.
segments.tr: - **食料作物**—直接食べられるために育てられます。穀物（トウモロコシ、小麦、米）、豆類（大豆、乾燥豆）、でんぷん質の根菜（じゃがいも、サツマイモ）。大ざっぱに言えば、これらはカロリーを供給します。

segments.src: - **Industrial crops** (sometimes called *technical* or *cash* crops) — grown as raw material for processing rather than as a plate of food. Cotton and flax for fiber; soybeans, canola, and peanuts for oil; sugarcane and sugar beets for sugar; tobacco, hops, and hemp as specialty inputs.
segments.tr: - **産業作物**（*技術作物*または*商業作物*とも呼ばれる）—食べ物の皿としてではなく、加工用の原材料として育てられます。繊維用の綿と亜麻；油用の大豆、菜種、ピーナッツ；砂糖用のサトウキビとテンサイ；タバコ、ホップ、ヘンプは特殊な投入物として。

segments.src: Note that the line is fuzzy on purpose.
segments.tr: この線引きは意図的に曖昧です。

segments.src: Soybeans are a food crop and an oil crop and a livestock feed.
segments.tr: 大豆は食料作物であり、油料作物であり、家畜飼料でもあります。

segments.src: Corn is breakfast cereal, ethanol, high-fructose corn syrup, and cattle feed.
segments.tr: トウモロコシは朝食シリアル、エタノール、高フルクトースコーンシロップ、牛飼料です。

segments.src: Classification follows **intended use**, not botany, so the same species can sit in two boxes at once.
segments.tr: 分類は植物学ではなく**用途**に従うため、同じ種が2つのカテゴリーに同時に属することができます。

segments.src: A second useful split is by **life span**:
segments.tr: もう一つ有用な分け方は**ライフサイクル**です：

segments.src: - **Annuals** finish seed-to-seed in one season (corn, soybeans, wheat).
segments.tr: - **一年生植物**は1つの季節で種から種まで完成します（トウモロコシ、大豆、小麦）。

segments.src: - **Biennials** need two seasons (sugar beets, carrots grown for seed).
segments.tr: - **二年生植物**は2つの季節が必要です（テンサイ、種用ニンジン）。

segments.src: - **Perennials** live for years (alfalfa, asparagus, apple trees, grapevines).
segments.tr: - **多年生植物**は数年間生きます（アルファルファ、アスパラガス、リンゴの木、ブドウの木）。

segments.src: Now the second half of today's lesson: **growth stages**.
segments.tr: 次に本日のレッスンの後半です：**成長段階**。

segments.src: Whatever the category, a crop moves through a recognizable sequence:
segments.tr: どのカテゴリーであろうと、作物は認識可能なシーケンスを通じて進みます：

segments.src: 1. **Germination and emergence** — the seed takes up water, the root and shoot break out, the seedling reaches light.
segments.tr: 1. **発芽と萌芽**—種は水を吸収し、根と茎が出て、苗が光に達します。

segments.src: 2. **Vegetative growth** — leaves, stems, and roots build the factory. No yield yet, just capacity.
segments.tr: 2. **栄養成長**—葉、茎、根が工場を構築します。まだ収量はなく、容量だけです。

segments.src: 3. **Reproductive growth** — flowering and pollination. The plant switches from building to committing.
segments.tr: 3. **生殖成長**—開花と受粉。植物は構築から実結に切り替わります。

segments.src: 4. **Grain fill / fruit development** — sugars made in the leaves get moved into seeds, tubers, or fruit.
segments.tr: 4. **粒充実/果実発育**—葉で作られた糖は種、塊茎、または果実に移動します。

segments.src: 5. **Maturity and senescence** — moisture drops, the plant shuts down, harvest window opens.
segments.tr: 5. **成熟と老化**—水分が低下し、植物はシャットダウンし、収穫ウィンドウが開きます。

segments.src: Agronomists give these stages formal codes.
segments.tr: 農学者はこれらの段階に正式なコードを付与します。

segments.src: Corn uses V-stages and R-stages (V6 = six collared leaves, R1 = silking, R6 = physiological maturity).
segments.tr: トウモロコシはV段階とR段階を使用します（V6 = 6葉展開、R1 = 抽穂、R6 = 生理的成熟）。

segments.src: Soybeans use their own V/R scale.
segments.tr: 大豆は独自のV/Rスケールを使用します。

segments.src: Many crops worldwide use the **BBCH scale**, a 0–99 numbering system that lets a researcher in Nebraska and one in France mean the same thing by "stage 65."
segments.tr: 世界中の多くの作物は**BBCH尺度**を使用します。これは0～99の数値体系で、ネブラスカの研究者とフランスの研究者が「ステージ65」で同じ意味になるようにします。

segments.src: Why bother with stages?
segments.tr: なぜ段階に手間をかけるのか？

segments.src: Because **timing is the whole game**.
segments.tr: なぜなら**タイミングがすべての鍵**だからです。

segments.src: The same input at a different stage gives a different result.
segments.tr: 異なる段階での同じ投入は異なる結果をもたらします。

segments.src: Nitrogen at V6 corn feeds a plant that's about to explode in growth; the same nitrogen at R5 is largely wasted.
segments.tr: V6段階のトウモロコシへの窒素は、成長爆発の直前の植物を養います；R5段階での同じ窒素はほぼ無駄です。

segments.src: A week of drought at silking costs far more yield than a week of drought in early vegetative growth.
segments.tr: 抽穂時の1週間の干ばつは、初期栄養成長時の1週間の干ばつよりもはるかに多くの収量を失わせます。

segments.src: Stage-awareness is how a farmer turns a calendar into a decision tool.
segments.tr: 段階認識は、農家がカレンダーを意思決定ツールに変える方法です。

segments.src: And what drives movement through those stages?
segments.tr: では、何がそれらの段階を通じて動きを駆動するのか？

segments.src: Five **environmental factors**:
segments.tr: 5つの**環境要因**：

segments.src: - **Temperature** — the pace-setter. Development tracks accumulated heat, not days. Hence *growing degree days*, computed in plain terms as `GDD = (daily high + daily low) / 2 - base temperature`, with corn's base commonly taken as 50 degrees F.
segments.tr: - **温度**—ペースセッター。発育は積算熱を追跡します、日数ではなく。したがって*積算温度*、プレーンな用語で計算される`GDD = (daily high + daily low) / 2 - base temperature`、トウモロコシの基準値は一般的に50度Fです。

segments.src: - **Water** — the solvent, the transport system, and the coolant. Both drought and waterlogging (which starves roots of oxygen) cut yield.
segments.tr: - **水**—溶剤、輸送システム、冷却剤。干ばつと湿害（根を酸素不足にする）の両方が収量を減らします。

segments.src: - **Light** — energy for photosynthesis, and for many crops a *signal*. Short-day plants like soybeans start flowering as nights lengthen, which is why a variety bred for Iowa behaves strangely in Georgia.
segments.tr: - **光**—光合成のエネルギー、そして多くの作物にとって*シグナル*。大豆のような短日植物は夜が長くなると開花を始めます。これはアイオワ州用に育成された品種がジョージア州で奇妙に振る舞う理由です。

segments.src: - **Soil and nutrients** — texture, pH, organic matter, and the supply of nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, and micronutrients.
segments.tr: - **土壌と養分**—質感、pH、有機物、および窒素、リン、カリウム、微量栄養素の供給。

segments.src: - **Air** — carbon dioxide as photosynthetic raw material, plus wind and oxygen at the root zone.
segments.tr: - **空気**—光合成の原料としての二酸化炭素、およびルートゾーンの風と酸素。

segments.src: The old agronomy shorthand still holds: yield tends to be capped by whichever factor is shortest in supply.
segments.tr: 古い農学の略語はまだ成り立ちます：収量は通常、供給が最も不足している要因によって上限が決まります。

segments.src: Perfect fertility doesn't rescue a crop that ran out of water at flowering.
segments.tr: 完璧な肥沃度は、開花時に水が枯れた作物を救いません。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活での例

segments.src: Picture an Iowa corn-and-soybean farm on a 1,000-acre section — the kind of operation you drive past for an hour straight on I-80.
segments.tr: アイオワ州の1,000エーカーセクションのトウモロコシと大豆の農場を想像してください—I-80で1時間ぶっ通しで車で通る種類の操業です。

segments.src: Late April: the planter goes in the ground once soil temperature at 2 inches holds near 50 degrees F.
segments.tr: 4月下旬：土壌温度が2インチで約50度Fに保たれると、プランターが地面に入ります。

segments.src: Plant into cold, wet soil and germination stalls, seedlings sit vulnerable, and stands come up ragged.
segments.tr: 冷たく湿った土に植えると発芽が停止し、苗は脆弱になり、立ち上がりがボロボロになります。

segments.src: That single temperature threshold is why planting is a weather decision, not a date on the wall.
segments.tr: その単一の温度閾値が、植え付けがカレンダーの日付ではなく気象に基づく決定である理由です。

segments.src: Mid-June: the corn is knee-high to chest-high, somewhere around V8.
segments.tr: 6月中旬：トウモロコシは膝から胸くらいの高さで、V8段階付近です。

segments.src: This is vegetative growth — the plant is building leaf area and setting the number of kernel rows it will *attempt* to fill.
segments.tr: これは栄養成長です—植物は葉面積を構築し、充実させる*予定*の粒行数を設定しています。

segments.src: Side-dress nitrogen goes on here, because the crop is about to take up the bulk of its season-long nitrogen in a few short weeks.
segments.tr: サイドドレス窒素はここで施用されます。作物が数週間で季節全体の窒素の大部分を吸収しようとしているからです。

segments.src: Mid-July: **silking**, stage R1.
segments.tr: 7月中旬：**抽穂**、ステージR1。

segments.src: This is the most drought-sensitive moment of the entire season.
segments.tr: これは1シーズン全体で最も干ばつに敏感な瞬間です。

segments.src: Pollen sheds from the tassel, silks catch it, kernels get set.
segments.tr: 花粉はタッセルから散布され、絹糸がそれをキャッチし、粒がセットされます。

segments.src: A heat wave now — the sort that spikes into the high 90s for a week — can cause pollination failure, and the farmer will find ears with gaps and bare tips at harvest.
segments.tr: 今の熱波—1週間で90度台後半にスパイクする種類—は受粉失敗を引き起こす可能性があり、農家は収穫時に隙間のあるトウモロコシや裸の先端を見つけます。

segments.src: Nothing done in August fixes that.
segments.tr: 8月に何をしても修正できません。

segments.src: Crop insurance markets and Chicago corn futures move on exactly this two-week window, which is why grain traders watch July forecasts the way sports fans watch a playoff bracket.
segments.tr: 穀物保険市場とシカゴ・トウモロコシ先物市場はまさにこの2週間のウィンドウで動きます。これが穀物トレーダーがスポーツファンがプレーオフブラケットを見るのと同じように7月の予報を見ている理由です。

segments.src: Early September: **black layer**, stage R6, physiological maturity.
segments.tr: 9月初旬：**黒色層**、ステージR6、生理的成熟。

segments.src: The kernel forms a dark abscission layer at its base and stops accumulating dry matter.
segments.tr: 粒はその基部に暗い離層を形成し、乾物の蓄積を停止します。

segments.src: Yield is now locked.
segments.tr: 収量は確定します。

segments.src: Everything from here is a drying-and-logistics problem: harvest at around 20–25 percent kernel moisture, then run the grain dryer down to about 15 percent for safe storage.
segments.tr: ここからのすべてはドライングと物流の問題です：粒水分が約20～25％の時に収穫し、その後穀物乾燥機を安全な保管のために約15％まで低下させます。

segments.src: Propane for that dryer can run tens of thousands of dollars for a wet fall — a real line item, not a rounding error.
segments.tr: その乾燥機のプロパンは湿った秋で数万ドルを費やす可能性があります—丸め誤差ではなく、実際の項目です。

segments.src: Meanwhile the same farm's soybeans are running their own R-scale, and 600 miles south in the Mississippi Delta a cotton grower — an industrial crop, grown for fiber, not calories — is tracking squares, blooms, and bolls on a completely different clock.
segments.tr: 一方、同じ農場の大豆は独自のRスケールで実行されており、600マイル南のミシシッピ・デルタで綿栽培者（産業作物、繊維用、カロリー用ではなく）は完全に異なるクロックで花芽、花、綿実を追跡しています。

segments.src: Same five environmental factors.
segments.tr: 同じ5つの環境要因。

segments.src: Same underlying logic.
segments.tr: 同じ基本的なロジック。

segments.src: Different crop class, different calendar, different market.
segments.tr: 異なる作物クラス、異なるカレンダー、異なる市場。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3行の要約

segments.src: 1. Crops are grouped by intended use — food crops for direct eating, industrial crops as raw material for fiber, oil, sugar, and specialty processing — and by life span as annuals, biennials, or perennials.
segments.tr: 1. 作物は用途別に分類されます—直接食べる食料作物、繊維、油、砂糖、特殊加工用の原材料としての産業作物—、そしてライフサイクルで一年生、二年生、多年生として。

segments.src: 2. Every crop moves through germination, vegetative growth, reproduction, filling, and maturity, and agronomists code those stages (corn V/R, the international BBCH scale) so that management decisions can be timed instead of guessed.
segments.tr: 2. すべての作物は発芽、栄養成長、生殖成長、充実、成熟を通じて進み、農学者はこれらの段階にコードを付与します（トウモロコシV/R、国際的なBBCH尺度）。管理決定は推測ではなくタイミングに基づきます。

segments.src: 3. Progress through the stages is driven by temperature, water, light, soil nutrients, and air, and yield is typically limited by whichever of those is shortest at the crop's most sensitive moment.
segments.tr: 3. 段階を通じた進行は温度、水、光、土壌養分、空気によって駆動され、収量は通常、作物の最も敏感な瞬間で最も不足しているもので制限されます。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 自己クイズ

segments.src: **Q1.** Cotton grown for fiber is best classified as which of the following?
segments.tr: **Q1.** 繊維用に栽培される綿は、次のいずれに最も分類されるか？

segments.src: - A) A food crop
segments.tr: - A) 食料作物

segments.src: - B) An industrial crop
segments.tr: - B) 産業作物

segments.src: - C) A biennial forage crop
segments.tr: - C) 二年生飼料作物

segments.src: - D) A cover crop
segments.tr: - D) カバークロップ

segments.src: **Q2.** True or False: A soybean plant classified as an annual completes its seed-to-seed life cycle within a single growing season.
segments.tr: **Q2.** 真または偽：一年生に分類された大豆植物は、単一の成長シーズン内にその種から種までのライフサイクルを完成させます。

segments.src: **Q3.** For a corn crop, which growth stage is generally the most sensitive to drought and heat stress?
segments.tr: **Q3.** トウモロコシ作物の場合、一般的に干ばつと熱ストレスに最も敏感な成長段階はどれか？

segments.src: - A) Emergence (VE)
segments.tr: - A) 萌芽（VE）

segments.src: - B) Six-leaf vegetative growth (V6)
segments.tr: - B) 6葉展開（V6）

segments.src: - C) Silking and pollination (R1)
segments.tr: - C) 抽穂と受粉（R1）

segments.src: - D) Physiological maturity, or black layer (R6)
segments.tr: - D) 生理的成熟または黒色層（R6）

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Glossary
segments.tr: ## 📚 本日の用語集

segments.src: - **Food crop** — a crop grown mainly to be consumed directly as human food, such as grains, pulses, and starchy tubers.
segments.tr: - **食料作物**—穀物、豆類、でんぷん質塊茎など、主に人間が直接食べるために栽培される作物。

segments.src: - **Industrial crop** — a crop grown as raw material for processing into fiber, oil, sugar, or other non-food products, such as cotton, canola, or sugarcane.
segments.tr: - **産業作物**—綿、菜種、サトウキビなど、繊維、油、砂糖、または他の非食品製品に加工するための原材料として栽培される作物。

segments.src: - **Annual / biennial / perennial** — plants that complete their life cycle in one season, two seasons, or that persist and produce for multiple years.
segments.tr: - **一年生/二年生/多年生**—1シーズン、2シーズン、またはその間生育し複数年間産出する植物のライフサイクルを完成させるもの。

segments.src: - **Growth stage** — a defined step in a crop's development (germination, vegetative, reproductive, filling, maturity) used to time management decisions.
segments.tr: - **成長段階**—作物の発育の定義されたステップ（発芽、栄養成長、生殖成長、充実、成熟）で、管理決定のタイミング決めに使用。

segments.src: - **Growing degree days (GDD)** — accumulated heat units used to predict crop development, since crops track temperature rather than calendar days.
segments.tr: - **積算温度（GDD）**—作物がカレンダーの日数ではなく温度を追跡するため、作物の発育を予測するために使用される累積熱単位。

segments.src: - **Physiological maturity** — the point at which a seed or fruit stops accumulating dry matter; in corn it is marked by the black layer at the kernel base.
segments.tr: - **生理的成熟**—種または果実が乾物の蓄積を停止する地点；トウモロコシでは粒の基部の黒色層によって標識されます。

segments.src: (Cottonseed oil is a reminder that one plant can serve more than one category.)
segments.tr: （綿実油は1つの植物が複数のカテゴリーに機能することを示唆します。）

segments.src: **Q2 — True.** Annuals such as soybeans, corn, and wheat go from seed to seed in a single season, which is why they are replanted every year.

de.title: [Landwirtschaft 101 #2] Mais, Baumwolle und Sojabohnen betreten das Feld: Wie Feldfrüchte sortiert werden und wie sie aufwachsen

segments.src: > Farmers don't just grow "plants" — they grow specific crop classes with specific end uses, and every one of them moves through the same predictable life stages, pushed along by five environmental levers.
segments.tr: > Landwirte bauen nicht einfach „Pflanzen" an – sie bauen spezifische Feldfrüchte mit spezifischen Verwendungszwecken an, und jede durchläuft die gleichen vorhersagbaren Lebensstadien, angetrieben durch fünf Umweltfaktoren.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Das heutige Konzept

segments.src: Walk through any farm and you'll see plants.
segments.tr: Gehen Sie durch jeden Bauernhof und Sie sehen Pflanzen.

segments.src: Walk through it like an agronomist and you'll see **categories**.
segments.tr: Gehen Sie hindurch wie ein Agronom und Sie sehen **Kategorien**.

segments.src: The first split is by **what the crop is for**.
segments.tr: Die erste Unterteilung erfolgt nach **wofür die Feldfrucht bestimmt ist**.

segments.src: Two of the big buckets:
segments.tr: Zwei der großen Kategorien:

segments.src: - **Food crops** — grown to be eaten more or less directly. Grains (corn, wheat, rice), pulses (soybeans, dry beans), and starchy roots and tubers (potatoes, sweet potatoes). Roughly speaking, these supply calories.
segments.tr: - **Nahrungsmittelfrüchte** – angebaut, um mehr oder weniger direkt gegessen zu werden. Getreide (Mais, Weizen, Reis), Hülsenfrüchte (Sojabohnen, Trockenbohnen) und stärkehaltige Wurzeln und Knollen (Kartoffeln, Süßkartoffeln). Grob gesagt liefern diese Kalorien.

segments.src: - **Industrial crops** (sometimes called *technical* or *cash* crops) — grown as raw material for processing rather than as a plate of food. Cotton and flax for fiber; soybeans, canola, and peanuts for oil; sugarcane and sugar beets for sugar; tobacco, hops, and hemp as specialty inputs.
segments.tr: - **Industriefrüchte** (manchmal *technische* oder *Cashcrops* genannt) – angebaut als Rohstoff für die Verarbeitung, nicht als Nahrung. Baumwolle und Leinen für Fasern; Sojabohnen, Raps und Erdnüsse für Öl; Zuckerrohr und Zuckerrüben für Zucker; Tabak, Hopfen und Hanf als Spezialzutaten.

segments.src: Note that the line is fuzzy on purpose.
segments.tr: Beachten Sie, dass die Grenzlinie absichtlich verschwommen ist.

segments.src: Soybeans are a food crop and an oil crop and a livestock feed.
segments.tr: Sojabohnen sind eine Nahrungsmittelfeldfrucht, eine Ölfeldfrucht und ein Tierfutter.

segments.src: Corn is breakfast cereal, ethanol, high-fructose corn syrup, and cattle feed.
segments.tr: Mais ist Frühstückscerealien, Ethanol, Hochfruktose-Maissirup und Rinderfutter.

segments.src: Classification follows **intended use**, not botany, so the same species can sit in two boxes at once.
segments.tr: Die Klassifizierung folgt der **beabsichtigten Verwendung**, nicht der Botanik, sodass die gleiche Art gleichzeitig in zwei Kategorien sein kann.

segments.src: A second useful split is by **life span**:
segments.tr: Eine zweite nützliche Unterteilung ist nach **Lebensdauer**:

segments.src: - **Annuals** finish seed-to-seed in one season (corn, soybeans, wheat).
segments.tr: - **Einjährige Pflanzen** schließen den Kreislauf von Samen zu Samen in einer Saison ab (Mais, Sojabohnen, Weizen).

segments.src: - **Biennials** need two seasons (sugar beets, carrots grown for seed).
segments.tr: - **Zweijährige Pflanzen** benötigen zwei Jahreszeiten (Zuckerrüben, Karotten für Saatgut).

segments.src: - **Perennials** live for years (alfalfa, asparagus, apple trees, grapevines).
segments.tr: - **Mehrjährige Pflanzen** leben für Jahre (Luzerne, Spargel, Apfelbäume, Weinreben).

segments.src: Now the second half of today's lesson: **growth stages**.
segments.tr: Jetzt zur zweiten Hälfte der heutigen Lektion: **Wachstumsstadien**.

segments.src: Whatever the category, a crop moves through a recognizable sequence:
segments.tr: Unabhängig von der Kategorie durchläuft eine Feldfrucht eine erkennbare Abfolge:

segments.src: 1. **Germination and emergence** — the seed takes up water, the root and shoot break out, the seedling reaches light.
segments.tr: 1. **Keimung und Auflaufen** – der Same nimmt Wasser auf, Wurzel und Trieb brechen durch, der Keimling erreicht das Licht.

segments.src: 2. **Vegetative growth** — leaves, stems, and roots build the factory. No yield yet, just capacity.
segments.tr: 2. **Vegetatives Wachstum** – Blätter, Stängel und Wurzeln bauen die Fabrik auf. Noch kein Ertrag, nur Kapazität.

segments.src: 3. **Reproductive growth** — flowering and pollination. The plant switches from building to committing.
segments.tr: 3. **Reproduktives Wachstum** – Blüte und Bestäubung. Die Pflanze wechselt vom Aufbau zur Verpflichtung.

segments.src: 4. **Grain fill / fruit development** — sugars made in the leaves get moved into seeds, tubers, or fruit.
segments.tr: 4. **Kornfüllung / Fruchtentwicklung** – Zucker aus den Blättern werden in Samen, Knollen oder Früchte transportiert.

segments.src: 5. **Maturity and senescence** — moisture drops, the plant shuts down, harvest window opens.
segments.tr: 5. **Reife und Seneszenz** – Feuchte sinkt, die Pflanze fährt herunter, das Ernte-Fenster öffnet sich.

segments.src: Agronomists give these stages formal codes.
segments.tr: Agronomen geben diesen Stadien formale Codes.

segments.src: Corn uses V-stages and R-stages (V6 = six collared leaves, R1 = silking, R6 = physiological maturity).
segments.tr: Mais verwendet V-Stadien und R-Stadien (V6 = sechs kollare Blätter, R1 = Seide, R6 = physiologische Reife).

segments.src: Soybeans use their own V/R scale.
segments.tr: Sojabohnen verwenden ihre eigene V/R-Skala.

segments.src: Many crops worldwide use the **BBCH scale**, a 0–99 numbering system that lets a researcher in Nebraska and one in France mean the same thing by "stage 65."
segments.tr: Viele Feldfrüchte weltweit verwenden die **BBCH-Skala**, ein 0–99-Nummerierungssystem, das einem Forscher in Nebraska und einem in Frankreich ermöglicht, mit „Stadium 65" das gleiche zu bedeuten.

segments.src: Why bother with stages?
segments.tr: Warum sich mit Stadien befassen?

segments.src: Because **timing is the whole game**.
segments.tr: Weil **Timing ist das Ganze Spiel**.

segments.src: The same input at a different stage gives a different result.
segments.tr: Die gleiche Eingabe in einem anderen Stadium gibt ein anderes Ergebnis.

segments.src: Nitrogen at V6 corn feeds a plant that's about to explode in growth; the same nitrogen at R5 is largely wasted.
segments.tr: Stickstoff bei V6-Mais füttert eine Pflanze, die gleich wachsen wird; der gleiche Stickstoff bei R5 wird weitgehend verschwendet.

segments.src: A week of drought at silking costs far more yield than a week of drought in early vegetative growth.
segments.tr: Eine Woche Trockenheit bei der Seide kostet viel mehr Ertrag als eine Woche Trockenheit im frühen vegetativen Wachstum.

segments.src: Stage-awareness is how a farmer turns a calendar into a decision tool.
segments.tr: Stadien-Bewusstsein ist, wie ein Landwirt einen Kalender in ein Entscheidungsinstrument verwandelt.

segments.src: And what drives movement through those stages?
segments.tr: Und was treibt die Bewegung durch diese Stadien voran?

segments.src: Five **environmental factors**:
segments.tr: Fünf **Umweltfaktoren**:

segments.src: - **Temperature** — the pace-setter. Development tracks accumulated heat, not days. Hence *growing degree days*, computed in plain terms as `GDD = (daily high + daily low) / 2 - base temperature`, with corn's base commonly taken as 50 degrees F.
segments.tr: - **Temperatur** – der Schrittmacher. Die Entwicklung folgt der akkumulierten Wärme, nicht den Tagen. Daher *Wachstumsgradtage*, einfach berechnet als `GDD = (Tageshoch + Tagestief) / 2 - Basistemperatur`, wobei Mais üblicherweise eine Basis von 50 Grad F hat.

segments.src: - **Water** — the solvent, the transport system, and the coolant. Both drought and waterlogging (which starves roots of oxygen) cut yield.
segments.tr: - **Wasser** – das Lösungsmittel, das Transportsystem und das Kühlmittel. Sowohl Trockenheit als auch Staunässe (die Wurzeln von Sauerstoff beraubt) reduzieren den Ertrag.

segments.src: - **Light** — energy for photosynthesis, and for many crops a *signal*. Short-day plants like soybeans start flowering as nights lengthen, which is why a variety bred for Iowa behaves strangely in Georgia.
segments.tr: - **Licht** – Energie für die Photosynthese und für viele Feldfrüchte ein *Signal*. Kurztagspflanzen wie Sojabohnen beginnen zu blühen, wenn die Nächte länger werden, weshalb eine für Iowa gezüchtete Sorte in Georgia seltsam reagiert.

segments.src: - **Soil and nutrients** — texture, pH, organic matter, and the supply of nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, and micronutrients.
segments.tr: - **Boden und Nährstoffe** – Textur, pH, organische Substanz und die Versorgung mit Stickstoff, Phosphor, Kalium und Mikronährstoffen.

segments.src: - **Air** — carbon dioxide as photosynthetic raw material, plus wind and oxygen at the root zone.
segments.tr: - **Luft** – Kohlendioxid als photosynthetischer Rohstoff, plus Wind und Sauerstoff in der Wurzelzone.

segments.src: The old agronomy shorthand still holds: yield tends to be capped by whichever factor is shortest in supply.
segments.tr: Die alte agronomische Faustregel gilt immer noch: Der Ertrag wird durch den Faktor begrenzt, der in kürzester Menge vorhanden ist.

segments.src: Perfect fertility doesn't rescue a crop that ran out of water at flowering.
segments.tr: Perfekte Fruchtbarkeit rettet keine Feldfrucht, die während der Blüte kein Wasser mehr hat.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im täglichen Leben

segments.src: Picture an Iowa corn-and-soybean farm on a 1,000-acre section — the kind of operation you drive past for an hour straight on I-80.
segments.tr: Stellen Sie sich einen Iowa Mais- und Sojabohnen-Betrieb auf einer 1.000-Acre-Fläche vor – die Art von Betrieb, an dem Sie eine Stunde lang auf der I-80 vorbeigehen.

segments.src: Late April: the planter goes in the ground once soil temperature at 2 inches holds near 50 degrees F.
segments.tr: Ende April: Die Sämaschine geht in den Boden, wenn die Bodentemperatur in 2 Zoll Tiefe etwa 50 Grad F beträgt.

segments.src: Plant into cold, wet soil and germination stalls, seedlings sit vulnerable, and stands come up ragged.
segments.tr: Das Pflanzen in kalten, nassen Boden lässt die Keimung stagnieren, Sämlinge sitzen verletzlich, und Bestände entstehen zerlumpt.

segments.src: That single temperature threshold is why planting is a weather decision, not a date on the wall.
segments.tr: Diese einzelne Temperaturschwelle ist der Grund, warum Pflanzen eine Wetter-Entscheidung ist, nicht ein Datum an der Wand.

segments.src: Mid-June: the corn is knee-high to chest-high, somewhere around V8.
segments.tr: Mitte Juni: Der Mais ist kniehoch bis brustbochhoch, etwa bei V8.

segments.src: This is vegetative growth — the plant is building leaf area and setting the number of kernel rows it will *attempt* to fill.
segments.tr: Dies ist vegetatives Wachstum – die Pflanze baut Blattfläche auf und bestimmt die Anzahl der Kornreihen, die sie *versuchen wird* zu füllen.

segments.src: Side-dress nitrogen goes on here, because the crop is about to take up the bulk of its season-long nitrogen in a few short weeks.
segments.tr: Seitliche Stickstoff-Düngung erfolgt hier, da die Feldfrucht kurz davor ist, den Großteil ihres saisonalen Stickstoffs in wenigen Wochen aufzunehmen.

segments.src: Mid-July: **silking**, stage R1.
segments.tr: Mitte Juli: **Seide**, Stadium R1.

segments.src: This is the most drought-sensitive moment of the entire season.
segments.tr: Dies ist der am empfindlichsten gegen Trockenheit moment der gesamten Saison.

segments.src: Pollen sheds from the tassel, silks catch it, kernels get set.
segments.tr: Pollen fällt aus der Quaste ab, Seide fängt sie auf, Körner werden gesetzt.

segments.src: A heat wave now — the sort that spikes into the high 90s for a week — can cause pollination failure, and the farmer will find ears with gaps and bare tips at harvest.
segments.tr: Eine Hitzewelle jetzt – die Art, die für eine Woche in die hohen 90er Jahre schießt – kann Bestäubungsausfall verursachen, und der Landwirt wird bei der Ernte Ohren mit Lücken und blanken Spitzen finden.

segments.src: Nothing done in August fixes that.
segments.tr: Nichts, das im August getan wird, behebt das.

segments.src: Crop insurance markets and Chicago corn futures move on exactly this two-week window, which is why grain traders watch July forecasts the way sports fans watch a playoff bracket.
segments.tr: Ernte-Versicherungsmärkte und Chicago-Maiszerminkontrakte bewegen sich genau in diesem Zwei-Wochen-Fenster, weshalb Getreidehandelsleute Juli-Prognosen wie Sportfans ein Playoff-Schauplatz beobachten.

segments.src: Early September: **black layer**, stage R6, physiological maturity.
segments.tr: Anfang September: **schwarze Schicht**, Stadium R6, physiologische Reife.

segments.src: The kernel forms a dark abscission layer at its base and stops accumulating dry matter.
segments.tr: Der Kern bildet eine dunkle Abszissions-Schicht an seiner Basis und stoppt die Ansammlung trockener Substanz.

segments.src: Yield is now locked.
segments.tr: Der Ertrag ist jetzt gesperrt.

segments.src: Everything from here is a drying-and-logistics problem: harvest at around 20–25 percent kernel moisture, then run the grain dryer down to about 15 percent for safe storage.
segments.tr: Alles ab hier ist ein Trocknungs- und Logistik-Problem: Ernte bei etwa 20–25 Prozent Kornfeuchte, dann führe den Getreidetrockner auf etwa 15 Prozent für sichere Lagerung herunter.

segments.src: Propane for that dryer can run tens of thousands of dollars for a wet fall — a real line item, not a rounding error.
segments.tr: Propan für diesen Trockner kann für einen nassen Herbst Zehntausende von Dollar kosten – ein echter Posten, kein Rundungsfehler.

segments.src: Meanwhile the same farm's soybeans are running their own R-scale, and 600 miles south in the Mississippi Delta a cotton grower — an industrial crop, grown for fiber, not calories — is tracking squares, blooms, and bolls on a completely different clock.
segments.tr: Inzwischen laufen die Sojabohnen desselben Hofes auf ihrer eigenen R-Skala, und 600 Meilen südlich im Mississippi Delta verfolgt ein Baumwollanbauer – eine Industriefeldfrucht, angebaut für Fasern, nicht für Kalorien – Quadrate, Blüten und Kapseln auf einer völlig anderen Uhr.

segments.src: Same five environmental factors.
segments.tr: Gleiche fünf Umweltfaktoren.

segments.src: Same underlying logic.
segments.tr: Gleiche zugrunde liegende Logik.

segments.src: Different crop class, different calendar, different market.
segments.tr: Unterschiedliche Feldfrüchte-Klasse, unterschiedlicher Kalender, unterschiedlicher Markt.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Drei-Zeilen-Zusammenfassung

segments.src: 1. Crops are grouped by intended use — food crops for direct eating, industrial crops as raw material for fiber, oil, sugar, and specialty processing — and by life span as annuals, biennials, or perennials.
segments.tr: 1. Feldfrüchte werden nach beabsichtigter Verwendung eingeteilt – Nahrungsmittelfrüchte für den direkten Verzehr, Industriefrüchte als Rohstoff für Fasern, Öl, Zucker und Spezialverarbeitung – und nach Lebensdauer als einjährig, zweijährig oder mehrjährig.

segments.src: 2. Every crop moves through germination, vegetative growth, reproduction, filling, and maturity, and agronomists code those stages (corn V/R, the international BBCH scale) so that management decisions can be timed instead of guessed.
segments.tr: 2. Jede Feldfrucht durchläuft Keimung, vegetatives Wachstum, Vermehrung, Füllung und Reife, und Agronomen codieren diese Stadien (Mais V/R, internationale BBCH-Skala), damit Managemententscheidungen zeitlich statt erraten werden können.

segments.src: 3. Progress through the stages is driven by temperature, water, light, soil nutrients, and air, and yield is typically limited by whichever of those is shortest at the crop's most sensitive moment.
segments.tr: 3. Der Fortschritt durch die Stadien wird durch Temperatur, Wasser, Licht, Bodennährstoffe und Luft angetrieben, und der Ertrag wird typischerweise durch denjenigen begrenzt, der am knappsten beim empfindlichsten Moment der Feldfrucht ist.
